ucs.title: [LLM] Volt Typhoon NTDS.dit theft via ntdsutil IFM / VSS shadow copy on Domain Controllers
ucs.description: Hunts the textbook Volt Typhoon (aka Vanguard Panda / VOLTZITE / DEV-0391) Domain Controller credential-harvest chain: ntdsutil 'create full' / 'ifm' to package the NTDS database, vssadmin/wmic shadow-copy creation to read NTDS.dit while locked, and reg.exe save of SYSTEM/SAM/SECURITY hives — all run from a Domain Admin context obtained via LOTL after edge-device exploitation.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name=ntdsutil.exe AND (Processes.process="*ifm*" OR Processes.process="*create full*" OR Processes.process="*ac i ntds*" OR Processes.process="*activate instance ntds*")) OR (Processes.process_name=vssadmin.exe AND Processes.process="*create*" AND Processes.process="*shadow*") OR (Processes.process_name=wmic.exe AND Processes.process="*shadowcopy*" AND Processes.process="*call*" AND Processes.process="*create*") OR (Processes.process_name=reg.exe AND Processes.process="*save*" AND (Processes.process="*hklm\\system*" OR Processes.process="*hklm\\sam*" OR Processes.process="*hklm\\security*")) OR (Processes.process_name=esentutl.exe AND Processes.process="*ntds.dit*") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user,"\$$") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where (FileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe"
         and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("ifm","create full","ac i ntds","activate instance ntds"))
     or (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe"
         and ProcessCommandLine has "create" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadow")
     or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe"
         and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy"
         and ProcessCommandLine has "create")
     or (FileName =~ "reg.exe"
         and ProcessCommandLine has "save"
         and ProcessCommandLine has_any (@"hklm\system", @"hklm\sam", @"hklm\security"))
     or (FileName =~ "esentutl.exe"
         and ProcessCommandLine has "ntds.dit")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"           // exclude machine acct noise
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend Image = tolower(NewProcessName), Cmd = tolower(CommandLine)
| where (Image endswith "\\ntdsutil.exe"
         and (Cmd has "ifm" or Cmd has "create full"
              or Cmd has "ac i ntds" or Cmd has "activate instance ntds"))
     or (Image endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" and Cmd has "create" and Cmd has "shadow")
     or (Image endswith "\\wmic.exe" and Cmd has "shadowcopy" and Cmd has "create")
     or (Image endswith "\\reg.exe" and Cmd has "save"
         and (Cmd has "hklm\\system" or Cmd has "hklm\\sam" or Cmd has "hklm\\security"))
     or (Image endswith "\\esentutl.exe" and Cmd has "ntds.dit")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName,
          CommandLine, ParentProcessName, TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Volt Typhoon NTDS.dit / SAM Hive Theft via LOTL Chain
id: c4e2a8d2-7f1d-4f9b-b1a2-volt-ntds-001
status: experimental
description: Detects the Volt Typhoon credential-harvest chain on Domain Controllers — ntdsutil IFM packaging, vssadmin/wmic shadow-copy creation to read NTDS.dit, reg.exe SYSTEM/SAM hive save, and esentutl staging of ntds.dit. Volt Typhoon performs no malware drop on the DC; this LOTL chain is the only ground-truth artifact.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-038a
  - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2023/05/24/volt-typhoon-targets-us-critical-infrastructure-with-living-off-the-land-techniques/
author: SOC Detection Eng
date: 2024/02/08
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  ntdsutil_ifm:
    Image|endswith: '\ntdsutil.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'ifm'
      - 'create full'
      - 'ac i ntds'
      - 'activate instance ntds'
  vss_shadow:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\vssadmin.exe'
      - '\wmic.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'shadow'
      - 'create'
  hive_save:
    Image|endswith: '\reg.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'save'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'hklm\system'
      - 'hklm\sam'
      - 'hklm\security'
  ntds_extract:
    Image|endswith: '\esentutl.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'ntds.dit'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: (ntdsutil_ifm or vss_shadow or hive_save or ntds_extract) and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Authorised AD recovery drills using ntdsutil IFM
  - Backup software invoking VSS via WMI on member servers (scope by DC OU)
level: critical
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.003
  - attack.t1003.001
  - attack.t1006
  - detection.volt_typhoon
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) @EventID:(4688 OR 1) AND ((@Image:(*\\ntdsutil.exe OR *\\NTDSUTIL.EXE OR *\\Ntdsutil.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*ifm* OR *"create full"* OR *"ac i ntds"* OR *"activate instance ntds"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*shadow* AND @CommandLine:*create*) OR (@Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*shadowcopy* AND @CommandLine:*create*) OR (@Image:(*\\reg.exe OR *\\REG.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*save* AND @CommandLine:(*HKLM\\SYSTEM* OR *hklm\\system* OR *HKLM\\SAM* OR *hklm\\sam* OR *HKLM\\SECURITY* OR *hklm\\security*)) OR (@Image:(*\\esentutl.exe OR *\\ESENTUTL.EXE) AND @CommandLine:*ntds.dit*)) AND -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\ntdsutil\.exe$/i AND regex("(ifm|create full|ac i ntds|activate instance ntds)", field=CommandLine))

  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i AND regex("shadowcopy", field=CommandLine) AND regex("create", field=CommandLine))
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\reg\.exe$/i AND regex("save", field=CommandLine) AND regex("hklm\\\\(system|sam|security)", field=CommandLine))

| NOT (UserName=/\$$/)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName], function=count())
| sort(@timestamp, order=desc)

ucs.title: [LLM] Volt Typhoon netsh portproxy relay setup (KV-Botnet style internal pivot)
ucs.description: Hunts the Volt Typhoon / VOLTZITE signature of staging a Windows host as a TCP relay using `netsh interface portproxy add v4tov4` — typically chained off a compromised SOHO/edge device (KV-Botnet) to tunnel C2 deeper into the OT/ICS estate. Microsoft, CISA AA24-038A, and Lumen's Black Lotus Labs all identify this as Volt Typhoon's primary lateral-pivot persistence on Windows beachheads.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name=netsh.exe AND Processes.process="*portproxy*" AND Processes.process="*add*" AND (Processes.process="*v4tov4*" OR Processes.process="*v4tov6*" OR Processes.process="*listenport*") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where NOT match(user,"\$$") | rex field=process "listenport=(?<listen_port>\d+)" | rex field=process "connectaddress=(?<connect_ip>[\d\.]+)" | rex field=process "connectport=(?<connect_port>\d+)" | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
let PortProxyExec = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName =~ "netsh.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "portproxy"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has "add"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("v4tov4","v4tov6","listenport")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | extend ListenPort = extract(@"(?i)listenport\s*=\s*(\d+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
    | extend ConnectAddr = extract(@"(?i)connectaddress\s*=\s*([\d\.]+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
    | extend ConnectPort = extract(@"(?i)connectport\s*=\s*(\d+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine,
              ListenPort, ConnectAddr, ConnectPort,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              ParentCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let PortProxyReg = DeviceRegistryEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RegistryKey has @"PortProxy\v4tov4"
    | where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, RegistryKey, RegistryValueName, RegistryValueData,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
union PortProxyExec, PortProxyReg
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend Image = tolower(NewProcessName), Cmd = tolower(CommandLine)
| where Image endswith "\\netsh.exe"
| where Cmd has "portproxy" and Cmd has "add"
| where Cmd has "v4tov4" or Cmd has "v4tov6" or Cmd has "listenport"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend ListenPort  = extract(@"(?i)listenport\s*=\s*(\d+)", 1, Cmd)
| extend ConnectAddr = extract(@"(?i)connectaddress\s*=\s*([\d\.]+)", 1, Cmd)
| extend ConnectPort = extract(@"(?i)connectport\s*=\s*(\d+)", 1, Cmd)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine,
          ParentProcessName, ListenPort, ConnectAddr, ConnectPort
| order by TimeGenerated desc

id: 8fa9b1e7-3c2d-4d1a-9b8e-volt-pp-002
status: experimental
description: Detects creation of a netsh portproxy v4tov4/v4tov6 rule — Volt Typhoon's signature technique for staging compromised Windows beachheads as TCP relays into OT/ICS networks (per CISA AA24-038A and Microsoft Threat Intel).
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-038a
  - https://blog.lumen.com/kv-botnet-dont-call-it-a-comeback/
author: SOC Detection Eng
date: 2024/02/08
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\netsh.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'portproxy'
      - 'add'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'v4tov4'
      - 'v4tov6'
      - 'listenport'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_img and selection_cmd and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Network engineers debugging dual-stack services
  - Documented internal port-forwarding for legacy apps (allow-list the listenport+connectaddress pair)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1090.001
  - attack.t1090
  - detection.volt_typhoon

| sort(@timestamp, order=desc)
